title: Apply the official-template workflow to every venue
description: Keeps known venue rules as strong checks while giving every other conference and journal the same Agent-first official author-kit workflow.
changes: Treat the automatic template allowlist as an optimization rather than the supported venue set.
For any other venue, verify official instructions and author kit for the exact year and paper type, then draft from the official sample.
Keep deterministic generic checks subordinate to Agent verification of official sources.

rollback.notes: Restore the prior workflow that did not define the unsupported-venue branch.
